You have never heard of this show. You just watched this whole clip (descriptions in brackets are what is on screen; speakers are described by how they look):
[On screen: Wide shot of the storm-lashed harbour, lanterns swinging on the quay.]
[Action: the figure in period dress slaps the cup from the man in period dress's hand and it shatters.]
a figure in period dress: "Order! I will have order in my hall!"
[Hard cut]
[On screen: Slow push-in on the the figure in period dress as the lamp flickers behind them.]
[Action: the the figure in period dress draws a short blade from a boot.]
a figure in period dress: "I kept that light burning for eleven winters."
[On screen: Close-up on the man in period dress's hands gripping the rail.]
a figure in period dress: "Nobody leaves this hall until I say so."
[On screen: Extreme close-up on the figure in period dress's eyes, wet with sea spray.]
[Action: the figure in period dress grabs the the figure in period dress by the wrist.]
a figure in period dress: "He is lying. Everyone knows he is lying!"
[On screen: Close-up on the figure in period dress's hands gripping the rail.]
[Action: the figure in period dress throws open the shutters; the storm floods in.]
a figure in period dress: "You were always too soft for this family."
[On screen: Slow push-in on the man in period dress as the lamp flickers behind them.]
a figure in period dress: "My father built this tower with his own hands."
[On screen: Close-up on the figure in period dress's jaw tightening.]
a figure in period dress: "Drink deep, little lamp-keeper."
[On screen: Close-up on the figure in period dress's jaw tightening.]
[On screen: Tight shot on a silver ring glinting in candlelight.]
a figure in period dress: "Lord Ashvale? That is impossible."
[On screen: Extreme close-up on the man in period dress's eyes, wet with sea spray.]
a figure in period dress: "He is lying. Everyone knows he is lying!"
